1. Set the cursor to null and scroll to the top. 
2. Drag `K` towards the bottom of the screen. 
3. Hold at the bottom of the screen just enough so that it autoscrolls slowly. 

## Current Behavior

`N` is expanded.

Thoughts should not be expanded on hover during autoscroll.
